subject: Semaphore model elevated 5xx — bridge notice & recovery commitments
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@tideanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Semaphore model — elevated 5xx rate (June 15) — bridging notice

Samir —

Quick heads up: starting ~08:48 PT this morning we observed an elevated 5xx rate (primarily 502/504) for requests routed to semaphore-6b-quant. The anomaly affected approximately 6% of inference traffic for your account over a ~30 minute window; some long-context generation requests saw higher error probability.

What we did immediately:
- Put an automatic routing rule in place to divert traffic from semaphore-6b-quant to semaphore-lite-3b for calls with <=1024 tokens.
- Enabled a temporary circuit-breaker increase for your tenant to allow in-flight requests to finish instead of aborting.
- Scoped and applied a hotfix to inference worker kernel selection to avoid a path that caused elevated memory pressure under mixed-quantized workloads.

Impact and next steps:
- We estimate customer-visible error rate returned to baseline by 09:20 PT after mitigations.
- We are running a targeted log extraction and trace collection (INF-4829) and preparing a short RCA.
- Attached is a bridging checklist and a draft RCA we will finalize tomorrow.

As next-step asks for you: please confirm whether you noticed any user-facing retries or failed jobs tied to a specific route or API key — that will help us validate our mitigation.

Apologies for the disruption — we know these failures are disruptive. I will follow up with the post-incident summary and specific, time-bound commitments.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0173

Attachments: semaphore_incident-bridging-checklist.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:45:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Semaphore model — elevated 5xx rate (June 15) — bridging notice

Rachel — thanks for the note and heads up. Adding a few internal details / immediate tasks: 

1) Root cause signal: initial traces show a kernel selection path that triggers an oversized cuBLAS workspace allocation on a subset of quantized transformer layers when sequence length > 1800 and batch packing is uneven. That causes OOM/retry behavior on the worker pool which surfaces as 502s.

2) What we did (ops):
- Rolled out kernel-selection guard to 25% of workers at 09:00 PT, then to 100% at 09:10 PT.
- Forced rider routing to semaphore-lite-3b for <=1024 tokens at 09:05 PT to reduce pressure.
- Temporarily disabled dynamic packer for API key blocks that matched your highest-throughput endpoints.

3) Short-term mitigation plan (owners):
- Ben to push a safe-mode quantization path that reduces workspace size (ETA 4 hours) — ben.carter@redwood.ai
- Ops to add an additional worker pool with different memory tuning (ETA 2 hours) — infra-oncall
- CS to coordinate a customer-facing note with timeline and follow-ups (Rachel) — rachel.kim@redwood.ai

I will attach trace samples to INF-4829. We should also flag the model for a forced rollback to previous quant config if we see another brief spike.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Inference Ops

Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Semaphore incident post-incident summary & commitments (INF-4829)

Samir —

Attached is the post-incident summary and our action plan (semaphore_rca-draft.md). Below is an executive summary and the items we are committing to execute this quarter: 

Executive summary:
- Event window: 2027-06-15 08:48–09:20 PT. Elevated 502/504 errors caused by a kernel-selection path interacting poorly with mixed-quantized layers under high sequence-length + uneven packing.\n- Customer impact: ~6% of calls for your tenant routed to semaphore-6b-quant during the window saw 5xx. Tide Analytics reported a small number of job retries and two customer timeouts.\n- Immediate mitigations: routing to semaphore-lite-3b, circuit-breaker tuning, kernel-selection guard.\n
Committed actions and owners (with dates):
- Code patch: finalize safe quantization fallback (Ben Carter) — deploy by 2027-06-16 20:00 PT.
- Model policy: create an API-key-level routing recommendation document for Tide (CS) — deliverable 2027-06-17.
- Audit: ingest extracted logs and attach to INF-4829 for customer verification (Ops) — complete by 2027-06-17 12:00 PT.
- SLA/credits: our finance & commercial team will evaluate the outage window for account-level credits and provide a formal response by 2027-06-18. I will loop in your account rep after ops closes INF-4829.

Attachments included: semaphore_rca-draft.md, INF-4829-log-extracts.zip, semaphore_incident-bridging-checklist.pdf

If you’re available, let’s schedule a 30 minute sync tomorrow to walk through the RCA and recommended routing/guardrails (I can host; invite to follow).

Appreciate the quick coordination — we’ll follow through on the commitments above and update you as items complete.

—Rachel
